title: The upward import assembled from a string at runtime
rule: core sits below edge, so core may not import edge
why: importlib.import_module("acme.edge.thing") is the dependency, and the layering is broken as thoroughly as by any import statement. No static reader can be expected to catch it in general, so the honest expectation is `violation` and the honest report is that nobody agrees. This case is here to keep that limit written down rather than discovered by whoever trusted the green tick.
